input: Any commit that modifies a /moves/<agent>.text path must also modify /turn/ply.num, and must be signed by the key of the agent named in the plan at /plan/agent.id plus at least twelve other Black agents' keys, so that only the planned piece's move can be accepted and an off-plan piece such as bishop_f8 cannot get its own move through.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/plan/agent.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false)
